message: San templates contain 1 invalid event binding(s).
suggestion: Replace empty on-* handlers with named methods; use San value modifiers such as on-click="stop:handleClick", not on-click.stop; move direct state assignments into handlers using this.data.set(...).

message: San computed callbacks call component methods unavailable in their computed context: isOverdue
suggestion: Move reusable calculations to pure functions and pass this.data.get(...) values explicitly; do not call this.method(...) inside computed.

message: 模板 text 渲染表达式调用 getTaskCount(...)，但该方法内部隐藏读取响应式字段：tasks。这些字段变化时，San 可能不会重新计算该绑定。
suggestion: 在模板表达式中直接引用 tasks，或将这些字段作为参数显式传给 getTaskCount(...)。
